# Brand asset sources

Original logo files used solely to identify their corresponding token, protocol, or wallet. Artwork remains owned by each project; inclusion does not imply an affiliation. No files have been recolored or redrawn.

- **SOL** — `sol.svg` — [Official project source](https://solana.com/branding)
- **USDC** — `usdc.png` — [Official project source](https://github.com/solana-labs/token-list)
- **BONK** — `bonk.png` — [Official project source](https://bonkcoin.com/)
- **WIF** — `wif.png` — [Official project source](https://dogwifcoin.org/)
- **JUP** — `jup.svg` — [Official project source](https://jup.ag/)
- **Raydium** — `raydium.svg` — [Official project source](https://github.com/raydium-io/media-assets)
- **Orca** — `orca.png` — [Official project source](https://www.orca.so/)
- **Meteora** — `meteora.svg` — [Official project source](https://www.meteora.ag/)
- **Phantom** — `phantom.svg` — [Official project source](https://phantom.com/)
- **Solflare** — `solflare.svg` — [Official project source](https://www.solflare.com/)
- **Backpack** — `backpack.png` — [Official project source](https://backpack.app/)

The USDC token icon is from the official Solana Labs token metadata repository, linked by the Jupiter app. All other files were downloaded from the corresponding project website or its official media repository. Source URLs and content checksums are recorded in `manifest.json`.
